content:
marta: Heads-up: got a customer bug where our onboarding sampleapp creates duplicate orders. Repro pattern: placeOrder -> 429 -> client retries with tiny fixed jitter (25-60ms) -> auth auto-refresh completes mid-retry -> server records duplicate.

marta: log excerpt:
```
2026-05-04T09:21:10Z WARN 429 order=req-222 backoff=32ms
2026-05-04T09:21:10Z INFO auth refresh start user=222
2026-05-04T09:21:10Z INFO retry order=req-222 headers=(authorization: Bearer newtok) // idempotency header MISSING
2026-05-04T09:21:10Z INFO server created order id=ord-1002 duplicate=true
```

kevin: this is similar to previous replay-id-loss threads but with an extra wrinkle: the sampleapp was using fixed small jitter (bad), and our retry clone path does a shallow copy that drops req.meta. So two failure modes interact.

li: do we have guidance on both sides: (A) SDK should preserve idempotency header across refresh/clone, (B) backoff defaults should avoid deterministic refresh windows?

anita: I propose a compact mitigation plan: 1) SDK change: generate a per-logical-request idempotency token at API boundary and store in request context so auth refresh or client swap doesn't drop it; 2) transport change: when cloning for retry, always merge meta->headers explicitly; 3) server-side belt: keep short TTL dedupe keyed by (user, idempotency-token) for 5 minutes to protect older clients.

kevin: agree. Also recommend changing sampleapp defaults immediately: move from fixed tiny jitter to exp-backoff base=100ms jitter 0.5, min backoff 100ms for 429. That buys time against common refresh windows (~40-150ms).

marta: quick pseudo for SDK (Node) to make sure it's clear:
```js
// at public API entry
const idemp = opts.headers['x-rw-replay-id'] || uuid.v4();
req.ctx = Object.assign({}, req.ctx, { replayId: idemp });
req.headers['x-rw-replay-id'] = idemp;
await auth.ensureValid(req.ctx); // ctx persists through refresh
return transport.send(req);
```

li: for Go we recommend: context.WithValue(ctx, "rw.replay.id", id) and ensure http.Request clones copy ctx. For Python: attach to requests.Session-level request context or pass via prepared_request._meta and ensure retry copies it.

anita: test plan: unit + integration harness that simulates token rotation mid-retry and asserts no duplicate side-effects for create endpoints; separate test for streaming/multipart where we assert sequence header semantics.

kevin: sequence header idea: x-rw-replay-seq for chunked streams; server dedups based on (replay-id, seq). We'll include that in spec. Also call out that replay-id must be generated per logical request (not per HTTP connection) and must not be reused across unrelated calls.

marta: CI change: add a small flaky-e2e job to sampleapp matrix that runs the token-rotate-mid-retry harness. If it flakes above threshold, fail.

ci-bot: created ticket DEVEX-5412: replay-guard-and-backoff -> assigned devex + eng-platform

ops-bot: temporary config change applied: sampleapp 429 min-backoff=150ms until SDK parity patch lands

li: small spec excerpt to sync across SDKs:
```
header: x-rw-replay-id (uuidv4 string)
semantics:
  - generated at API boundary
  - binds to logical request lifetime
  - immutable across retries for that logical request
optional header: x-rw-replay-seq (int)
server: dedupe key=(user, replay-id) TTL=5m; for streams also consider max-seq seen
sdk guidance:
  - attach header BEFORE calling auth.ensureValid()
  - carry via request context so refresh doesn't drop it
  - retry clones must merge meta->headers
  - default 429 backoff: exp backoff base=100ms, max=2s, jitter=0.5
```

anita: I'll draft a one-page spec and 3 minimal code snippets (Node/Go/Python) and open PRs with a small test harness repo. After Node PR lands we'll mirror to others.

kevin: add dashboards/metrics: duplicates_per_100k_requests per endpoint and retry_clone_missing_header_rate. Add an alert if duplicates > 2 per 100k for payment/order endpoints.

marta: thanks. i'll attach repro harness and the failing logs to the PR. planning to land a quick Node patch that: (1) attaches replay-id at API boundary, (2) preserves on clone, (3) includes test that fakes auth rotate mid-retry. ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:
